verdict.rationale: Gitea's own site says it can "sync seamlessly with tools like Slack, Discord, MS Teams, Lark, and more," naming all three chat tools in the story. It also offers webhooks for building custom workflows. However, the evidence is a single marketing-level claim with no detail on which repository or pull request events are delivered or how setup works. missing for 10: detailed docs on chat-integration setup and supported repo/PR event types, independent or hands-on corroboration.
